entities.summary: Henry de Jesús Rangel Silva was the governor of Trujillo, Venezuela in 2012-2021. A military general and former Minister of Defense, Rangel Silva was previously the head of Operational Strategic Command of the Venezuelan Armed Forces, head of the DISIP and Director of CANTV. Rangel Silva took part in the coup attempt of February 1992 together with Hugo Chávez.
